result.summary: Overall the page looks well-structured, but there is one notable visual glitch: a green block appears to bleed out from behind the search bar. A few minor layout/clipping issues exist in the horizontal card carousels.

issues.description: A solid green rectangle is visible protruding below and behind the search bar, on the right side. It looks like the green promotional banner or some background element is bleeding out from behind the search input, creating a stray visual artifact.
issues.suggestion: Fix the z-index/overflow of the search bar container or the promo banner so no background element extends beyond the search field's rounded corners.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right screen edge, with its name truncated. This may be intentional carousel behavior, but the truncation looks abrupt.
issues.suggestion: If this is a scrollable carousel, add a subtle partial-card peek or edge fade to signal scrollability; otherwise ensure full card names fit.

issues.description: The category chip row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy, ...) is cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip, with no visible affordance that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Add an edge fade or partial chip peek to indicate horizontal scrolling in the category filter row.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (-20% pizza) is clipped mid-image by the bottom navigation bar. This is normal scrolling state but the abrupt cut can look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Consider a slight bottom padding or fade above the bottom navigation bar so clipped content looks intentional.
